text.content:
Family, honor, Heywood.

Turf: Heywood, especially Vista del Rey
Known for: Blood ties; honor and loyalty; legitimate businesses fronting crime
Hangouts: El Coyote Cojo, Dicky Twister, La Catrina

The Valentinos are bound to their community by blood. Relatives run bars, corner shops, clubs and garages, and those businesses front money laundering, drug labs and chop shops. Betrayal is the worst crime a member can commit.

As far as they're concerned, they've always been part of Heywood.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.26
